Prism turns raw material (notes, transcripts, documents, photos) into proofed, on-brand files: sheets, brochures, 5x7 cards, PowerPoint decks, social posts and stories, carousels, email headers, HTML emails, blog posts, animated films and website illustrations, all laid out from one approved `content.md`.

**Install:** download `prism-<version>.zip` below and add it as a plugin in the Claude app. New to Prism? Run `/prism-tutorial` for a guided walkthrough on a sample piece.
